title: PRAGMA eponymous virtual-table runtime

scope.rationale: SQL table scans now resolve supported pragma_* eponymous modules before schema lookup, construct the declared visible/hidden column model, own cursors, execute the connection PRAGMA state, and expose row, EOF, column, and rowid callbacks.
excluded_responsibilities: Unsupported PRAGMA definitions and multi-row PRAGMA families
Full planner constraint transport from arbitrary WHERE clauses

external_source_responsibilities: Connection-level PRAGMA execution and VDBE virtual cursor opcodes
dependencies.caller_closure: The canonical SELECT compiler resolves supported pragma_* names before ordinary schema lookup.

inputs: Supported pragma_* eponymous table name with optional schema argument
outputs: One visible PRAGMA result row plus hidden argument/schema values
contracts.ownership: Statement owner retains table declaration and argument bytes; cursor clear/close releases copied arguments and handle memory.
contracts.state_and_results: Unknown modules fail lookup. Supported modules expose source column names, initialize rowid at one, and reach EOF after one next for the bounded PRAGMA set.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Uses existing connection PRAGMA and VDBE virtual-source paths.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: OOM and invalid arguments fail without leaking the table, cursor, declaration, or argument copies.

representation_differences: The native frontend resolves supported pragma_* modules directly into typed VirtualSource plans rather than inserting C sqlite3_module objects into a connection hash.

oracle.protocol: Compare direct PRAGMA, pragma_user_version table scan, pragma_cache_size schema argument, and surrounding advanced statements against pinned C.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact primary codes and integer values.

assurance.oom: Declaration, plan, cursor, arguments, metadata, and string result allocations have explicit cleanup.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No new I/O or lock protocol beyond the selected PRAGMA execution.
assurance.malformed_input: Unknown names, unsupported projections, excess arguments, and non-text literals fail cleanly.
assurance.continuation: Finalize closes the virtual cursor and leaves the connection usable.
assurance.performance: Constant-row bounded modules use one virtual cursor iteration.

integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_prepare_v2 -> compileTableScan -> compilePragmaVirtualScan -> VDBE virtual source callbacks

independent_review.notes: Broader PRAGMA families, planner constraints, assurance, and review remain open.

known_blockers: Expand supported PRAGMA families and multi-row results.
Complete internal trace and independent review.

implementation_spans: Complete pragma virtual-table module source body
Connection PRAGMA runtime and production SELECT virtual-source path
assertions_branches_cleanup: module lookup, declaration, hidden schema input, open, filter, column, rowid, next, EOF, clear, close, and OOM reviewed
